product_roadmap.windows_production_isolation: governed-turn machine-PROVEN in the live kit; SHIPPED gate still false (release blocker for the shipped app). The PURE §0.W core (core/src/windows_broker.rs) covers all five primitives cross-platform + unit-tested; TWO real syscall primitives (named-pipe peer-SID auth via ImpersonateNamedPipeClient; Authenticode via WinVerifyTrust) run on a windows-latest CI runner (crate brops-win-broker). NEW: the brops-win-live crate (apps/desktop/src-tauri/win-live) is the Rust twin of the Linux engine/ci/live kit and PROVES the FULL Windows governed turn to production trusted_verified: (1) an in-process full crypto chain (challenge -> lease -> attest -> sign -> verify_and_accept -> production_verified=true bound=true) that is HOST-INDEPENDENT and runs on the Linux CI runner (cargo test -p brops-win-live), so the one cross-impl boundary (the signer's JCS(payload) vs brops-core ReceiptEnvelope::payload_jcs) is byte-exact; (2) the same GovernedChain over REAL \\.\pipe\ named pipes across three separate Windows processes, same-account -> trusted_verified (production signer key, epoch 2); (3) the peer-SID gate fail-closed BOTH directions (correct broker SID -> verified, wrong broker SID -> blocked); (4) CROSS-ACCOUNT -> challenge-authority/supervisor/isolated-signer each as a DISTINCT dedicated Windows service account (session-0, batch logon), peer-SID authed across real account boundaries -> trusted_verified (see win-live/proof/CROSS_ACCOUNT_PROOF.md + win_live_proof.ps1). REMAINING to flip platform_governed_execution_supported() true in the SHIPPED app: the broker as its OWN dedicated service account (blocked by a session-0 console-launch STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED 0xC0000142 limitation that also affects the previously-working pipe_proof — environment, orthogonal to the chain), CreateProcessAsUser under a restricted token + STARTUPINFOEX handle list, CNG key custody, and a SEPARATE Architect audit of the Windows broker. Until then platform_governed_execution_supported() stays false on Windows and the shipped app fails closed.
product_roadmap.windows_live_proof: PROVEN in the brops-win-live kit (PR #53): in-process CI-portable crypto chain + real-named-pipe same-account (3 processes) + peer-SID gate both directions + cross-account (3 distinct dedicated service accounts). An INDEPENDENT adversarial audit (Architect-role, zero-trust) returned Linux/core-chain GREEN (verify_and_accept unforgeable by an in-scope adversary; shipped app genuinely fail-closed) and Windows-kit YELLOW with three P1/P2 gaps, ALL now ADDRESSED: (P1-a) the production-trust root is TCB-PINNED (compiled-in crate::tcb, never config.json; a config root that disagrees is refused); (P1-b) a production ManifestResolver now verifies the manifest vs the TCB root + anti-rollback + resolves the production key INSIDE the chain resolution, feeding the pinned key verify_and_accept verifies under (no more verify-beside-acceptance side-call); (P2) the anti-rollback floor is now PERSISTED atomically on resolve. A follow-up INDEPENDENT RE-AUDIT confirmed all three originals CLOSED and surfaced two residuals, now also fixed: R1 (the anti-rollback floor is TCB-SIGNED — floor.sig under a compiled-in TCB floor key — so a config-dir adversary who resets floor.json to replay an older genuinely-root-signed manifest is REJECTED on load; unit-tested) and R2 (the supervisor-attestation key is now resolved through resolve_production_key, enforcing trust_class/validity-window/revocation, not a bare key_id lookup). The restricted-token executor launch primitive (CreateRestrictedToken + CreateProcessAsUserW, §0.1 primitive 4) is also proven (win-broker restricted_launch). The broker-in-session-0 concern is closed by running the broker as SYSTEM (the TCB principal). The broker-in-session-0 concern is now CLOSED: the full cross-account turn is proven with the broker running as SYSTEM (LocalSystem) — the correct TCB deployment (holds SeAssignPrimaryToken/SeImpersonate, runs cleanly in session 0) — plus the three servers as distinct dedicated service accounts, peer-SID authed (allowlist = the broker SYSTEM SID S-1-5-18) -> trusted_verified. The earlier 0xC0000142 limitation only affected a NON-privileged service-account CONSOLE process doing child-spawning, not SYSTEM. Seed custody is now DONE: each principal seed is under per-user DPAPI (CryptProtectData, seal-on-first-use TOFU) so it is no longer plaintext at rest — only the owning service account can decrypt it (proven: a 64-byte plaintext seed becomes a 262-byte DPAPI blob after first server read, and a restart transparently unseals it). Still REMAINING before flipping platform_governed_execution_supported() true: a SEPARATE external Architect audit of the Windows broker. (A non-SYSTEM dedicated brops-broker account is an optional least-privilege future hardening.) Does NOT ship trusted_verified; the shipped Windows gate stays fail-closed.
